independence_statement: This audit is not an independent human or external-model review. It is a separate auditor-role replay in the same ChatGPT research session. D1 permits same-base-model logical role separation, but human review remains required before any R1/P1 qualified reference.

claim_audits.notes: Academy source supports multi-domain assessment and additional-information logic; case-specific incompleteness is a bounded inference, not a universal checklist.
Additional-information acquisition is directly represented as Nutrition Assessment critical thinking; no specific missing variable is predeclared mandatory.
Current corrected AHA guidance and measurement guidance support repeated/standardized measurement and professional diagnostic confirmation; claim correctly prohibits over-inference.
132.6667 is mechanically reproducible and falls in the current 130–139 systolic stage-1 category; claim explicitly separates numerical category match from confirmed diagnosis.
USPSTF recommendation is risk-factor conditioned; the case view lacks sufficient validated risk context for unqualified projection.
DGA supports general population dietary guidance; the non-equivalence to individualized DecisionReference is a Foundation/NDF scope rule rather than a direct DGA efficacy claim.
BMI 27 and recalculated 26.97 are mechanically reproducible and below the BMI>=30 population threshold for the cited USPSTF obesity behavioral recommendation.

conclusion: The bounded A3R claim set is reproducible from the frozen claim-support snapshots plus authorized case observations. The audit does not validate a DecisionReference or replace mandatory downstream human review.
